text.en:
The direct control and supervision
over the Philippine
Charity Sweepstakes Office shall hereby be transferred
from the Department of
Health to the Office of the President

All orders, issuances,
rules and regulations
or parls thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are herebv repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive
Order shall take effect immediatelv
